summary_ja: 事業法人等向けエクスポージャーのPDを一年間のPD推計値とし、事業法人・金融機関等向けは〇・〇五パーセントを下限、デフォルト格付は百パーセントとする。
summary_en: PD for corporate, etc. exposures is the one-year estimate for the obligor rating, with a 0.05% floor for corporates and financial institutions and 100% for defaulted exposures.
paragraphs: The PD used in the formula for the amount of credit risk-weighted assets and in calculating expected loss for corporate, etc. exposures shall be the one-year PD estimate relating to the obligor rating assigned to that corporate, etc. exposure.

Notwithstanding the preceding paragraph, the PD used in the formula for the amount of credit risk-weighted assets and in calculating expected loss for corporate exposures and exposures to financial institutions, etc. shall not be lower than 0.05%.
The PD of a corporate, etc. exposure assigned a rating equivalent to default shall be 100%.
